about: Every dataset the experiments read. Each lives in its own folder under the data root (MSSP_DATA_ROOT, or the author's Google Drive folder MyDrive/datasets), and its manifest pins every file by SHA-256. Check with: python3 datasets_tool.py verify --deep

CWRU_Bearing_NumPy.title: Case Western Reserve University bearing data, NumPy conversion
CWRU_Bearing_NumPy.license: not stated by either the conversion or the CWRU Bearing Data Center; cite the Data Center

NASA_IMS_Bearings.title: IMS bearing run-to-failure data, test 2 (NASA PCoE Prognostics Data Repository)
NASA_IMS_Bearings.version: test 2 only: the 984 one-second recordings 2004.02.12.10.32.39 to 2004.02.19.06.22.39, as used by the paper
NASA_IMS_Bearings.original: J. Lee, H. Qiu, G. Yu, J. Lin and Rexnord Technical Services (2007). IMS, University of Cincinnati. Bearing Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository
NASA_IMS_Bearings.license: public NASA data repository; cite as given in 'original'

fetch.instructions: Download the IMS bearing archive from the NASA Prognostics Data Repository and place the folder of test 2 recordings at NASA_IMS_Bearings/2nd_test/. The manifest identifies the exact files.

Ottawa_Bearing_TimeVaryingSpeed.title: Bearing vibration under time-varying rotational speed (University of Ottawa)
Ottawa_Bearing_TimeVaryingSpeed.version: Mendeley Data version 2, DOI 10.17632/v43hmbwxpm.2 (published 2019-02-06); 'Download All' archive v43hmbwxpm-2.zip, sha256 4e5538e71692c83e9f5a4338808983f2a9bb00bfdc4a4e4a9627b616f5794eb1
Ottawa_Bearing_TimeVaryingSpeed.original: H. Huang and N. Baddour, Bearing vibration data collected under time-varying rotational speed conditions, Data in Brief 21 (2018), doi:10.1016/j.dib.2018.11.019

fetch.instructions: Download 'Download All' from the Mendeley page (v43hmbwxpm-2.zip, 762 MB) and extract it into Ottawa_Bearing_TimeVaryingSpeed/, keeping the five folders as they are in the archive. 200 kHz, 10 s per file; Channel_1 accelerometer, Channel_2 encoder (1024 CPR).
